chunks: And in another report, he said:

If the people begin the morning fasting and do not see the crescent, then a group of trustworthy people comes testifying to the sighting, they should break their fast and go out the following day, at the beginning of the day, to their Eid.
And if the crescent of Shawwal is seen during the day before noon, then that day is from Shawwal; and if it is seen after noon, then that day is from the month of Ramadan.

key_terms.الْهِلَالَ: the crescent moon marking the new lunar month
key_terms.عِيدِهِمْ: their Eid prayer or Eid gathering

ai.seo_question: What should people do if the crescent of Shawwal is confirmed after they began the day fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the confirmation of the crescent of Shawwal after people have already begun the day fasting. It explains when they should break the fast and how the timing of daytime sighting affects whether the day is counted as Shawwal or still as Ramadan.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2038 - In another narration, it is reported:

"If the people begin their day fasting and do not see the crescent moon, but then a group of trustworthy individuals arrives and testifies to having seen it, they should break their fast and go out the next day, early in the morning, for their Eid."
